tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Find properties that are free for every night between checkIn and checkOut and can host the guests. Returns nightly price estimates, minimum-stay rules and booking links.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The exact live price of one stay at one property, with payment schedule and policies, or the reason it cannot be booked (dates taken, minimum stay, too many guests).

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Everything about one property: description, beds and bedrooms, amenities, views, pool, house rules, pet policy, policies, location, typical prices and photos.

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: Every property at Sumberkima Hill with its size and typical price. Does not check availability for dates.

tools.name: get_resort_information
tools.description: Location and how to get there, check-in and check-out times, payment and cancellation policies, currencies, contact details and key pages.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: A link for the guest to book a stay: the property page with the dates and guests chosen and the live price shown. Include the guest's details to have the booking form filled in for them (kept for 3 days). Nothing is booked or charged: the guest clicks Book, checks the details, accepts the rental agr
